{{Quote|Okay, Skritch&mdash;time ta load yer ''poison sacs''&mdash;|[[Gudb]] to his pet gorm worm [[Skritch]]|<ref name="TotJ3">[[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Poison sacs''' were part of the anatomical makeup of [[Gorm-worm/Legends|gorm worms]]. The lizard could fill these sacs with a potent [[Poison/Legends|venom]] that was strong enough to bring down large animals, and even an adult [[Human/Legends|human]].
